title: Shocking Alert: Anthropic Researcher Sees Over 10% Chance AI Could Exterminate Humans
subtitle: An AI expert warns that the technology carries more than a 10% chance of causing human extinction, intensifying the safety debate.
excerpt: An Anthropic researcher claims there is over a 10% probability that AI could wipe out humanity, adding to growing warnings about existential risk.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Concern about the future of artificial intelligence (AI) has entered a new, serious chapter. A researcher affiliated with Anthropic has expressed the belief that the technology has a greater than 10% chance of exterminating all human beings.

This assessment, pointing to a significant existential risk, comes as global discussions on AI safety intensify. The Anthropic researcher’s warning joins a growing series of alerts about the security threats posed by advancing AI.

The debate over AI safety has become a focal point for developers, researchers, and observers of the tech field. The nature of AI, with its processing power and autonomous learning, raises questions about control and long‑term societal impact. Security risks, as the alerts indicate, span a range of possibilities that require continuous attention during development and deployment.

The perception that AI could pose a threat capable of annihilating humanity, as voiced by the researcher, is among the most forceful warnings to emerge. This perspective underscores the urgency of addressing safety implications inherent to AI system development and application. The increasing prevalence of such warnings reflects growing caution and a search for solutions that safeguard human integrity and survival amid technological progress.

The escalation of warnings about AI dangers shows an evolution in the debate. Moving from a primarily technical discussion, the focus now expands to ethical and existential implications the technology may bring. With AI systems proliferating across many sectors, a deep analysis of potential risk scenarios is required. The belief that AI could, in more than one out of ten cases, be responsible for eradicating the human species marks a milestone in the ongoing conversation about responsibility and control over the technology shaping our future.

With information from BBC News.
